entities.name: Nicolae Mișu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolae Mișu was a Romanian tennis player and diplomat. He competed at the 1924 Summer Olympics and was also a member of Romanian Davis Cup team. His father, Nicolae Mișu, served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Romania.
